contract: Repository test sources executed by Quality CI must not silently introduce direct external network clients. Existing local server tests may use explicitly literal loopback targets only.
python_blocked: http.client connection to non-literal or non-loopback host
urllib.request.urlopen to non-literal or non-loopback URL
socket.create_connection to non-literal or non-loopback endpoint
fail_closed: Python direct client target not statically proven loopback
limitations: Source-level guard only. It does not prove an OS-level egress sandbox and does not fully exclude indirect networking through imported application modules.
boundary: No product/UI/schema/domain behavior, no sudo, no new workflow permission, no secret, no OIDC, no dependency installation and no browser/device gate promotion.
